# devva TypeScript client (vendored)

A built copy of the devva TypeScript client, the one the `devva-eval` battery runs against (it reads the
engine token from `DEVVA_TOKEN`). Plania loads `lib/index.js` at start; `DEVVA_CLIENT` names another
build. Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`. Replace this folder when the client is published under its new name.
